entries.name: Prompt-Injection RCE in Data Agents

triggerConditions: untrusted input or attacker-influenced SQL/DB content instructs the LLM to generate Python code
visualize=True (historical default) causes the LLM-generated Plotly code to be executed dynamically
injected instructions override pre-prompting safeguards
privilegeRequirements: execution privileges of the Vanna process

status.activityReferenceWindow: 2024-05 to 2024-06, open-source text-to-SQL deployments (CVE-2024-5565 published 2024-05-31; JFrog analysis 2024-06-27; independent Huntr discovery published as CVE-2024-5826; unpatched deployments of vanna <= 0.5.5 remain exploitable)

evidence: prompt-injection-to-RCE in agent toolchains: untrusted data steers LLM-generated code that is then executed (LangChain CSV 2023; Vanna text-to-SQL 2024)

sources.citation: NVD: CVE-2024-5565 (Vanna AI text-to-SQL prompt-injection leading to remote Python code execution; CWE-94 improper control of generated code; published 2024-05-31)

JFrog Security Research: When Prompts Go Rogue — Analyzing a Prompt Injection Code Execution in Vanna.AI (2024-06-27; 'integrated prompt injection' vs 'isolated'; visualize=True default executes LLM-generated Plotly code; remediation: visualize=False for untrusted requests, never execute generated code directly, sandbox, restrict privileges, authenticate interfaces)
GitHub Advisory GHSA-7735-w2jp-gvg6 (CVE-2024-5565; vanna <= 0.5.5 affected; unauthenticated attackers may execute commands with the Vanna process's privileges; CVSS 4.0 rated Critical by GitHub)

observables: text-to-SQL agent executing Python code generated from SQL context
LLM-generated Plotly code reaching dynamic exec
preconditions: untrusted input or attacker-influenced DB content reaching ask()
generated-code execution enabled (visualize=True) or unpatched version

mitigations.description: JFrog remediation guidance: disable visualization for untrusted requests (visualize=False), never execute LLM-generated code directly, sandbox unavoidable execution, restrict process/DB privileges, authenticate and filter exposed interfaces
